content:
Instantly ai reply or recommend program. Want to automate our first email response to their reply.
We use Instantly and have had incredible results. We use multiple domains and as we operate within a very specific niche and know our audience/appropriate messaging, we tend to get very high reply rates to the Instantly sequence I create with people who are genuinely interested in buying more. However, I have an issue. We use our sales people (actual humans) to send the first reply (to their first reply from the sequence). And they always forget to share their calendly link, check the time zone the person is in, attach wrong media kit etc. Therefore, it got me wondering, if anyone uses any automated AI response that actually works? My experience when I checked it out a while ago was that it sounded a bit corny and fake and didn't really "get" what the response was saying. But now I'm seeing more and more options coming out.
